subject: Evaluation charter, milestones, and point people
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@fintell.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Evaluation charter, milestones, and point people

Hi Elena — great talk earlier. Summary + proposed next steps below (quick read):

1) What we heard (qualification)
- Primary use: customer support summarization + intent routing for high-volume chat.
- Expected concurrency during trial: ~60 simultaneous agents, modal request length ~150 tokens.
- Success metrics: fidelity of extracts (F1 > 0.78 on your labelled set), 95th percentile generation latency < 220ms, cost target ~<$0.40 per 1k tokens for the baseline workload.

2) Proposed technical trial (4 weeks):
- Kickoff: week of Jul 13 — recommended kickoff Thu Jul 16 or Fri Jul 17 (1 hr).
- Sprint cadence: weekly 30-min check-ins (Fridays) + async status in the shared doc.
- Final readout: week of Aug 10 (customer-facing demo + metric readout).
- Deliverables: baseline integration guide, model config and quantization recommendation, 2 evaluation runs on your sample set, final readout deck.

3) Ownership (Redwood / Fintell):
- Redwood: Aditya (eng sponsor / success), Soojin (runtime + integration), Marcus (SRE / perf tuning).
- Fintell: Elena (ML lead), Rajiv (platform / infra), Caroline (procurement / contracting).

4) Dependencies from Fintell (requested this week):
- Sample dataset (CSV) with 500 labelled records for extract evaluation.
- IAM contact for granting limited access to a sandbox VPC (if you want a private trial).
- Completed security questionnaire (we can send a short SOC2 snapshot).

5) Risks / success criteria clarity:
- If we cannot get sample data by Jul 14 we’ll shift the readout by a week.
- If 95th latency target cannot be met with baseline config we’ll propose quick mitigations (prefix caching, model variant).

Attached: eval-charter-draft.pdf (one-page charter), redwood-security-snapshot.pdf (SOC2 highlights).

Next steps — please reply by EOD tomorrow with: preferred kickoff date, list of stakeholder emails to include on invites, and whether you want a hosted trial or VPC sandbox.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Eng, Solutions — Redwood Inference
(aditya@redwood.ai)

---
Attachment: eval-charter-draft.pdf (1 page, PDF)
Attachment: redwood-security-snapshot.pdf (3 pages, PDF)

From: Elena Moreno <elena@fintell.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@fintell.com>, Caroline Lee <caroline.lee@fintell.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 20:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evaluation charter, milestones, and point people

Thanks Aditya — helpful summary. We’re aligned on most of this; a few clarifications and requests: 

- Kickoff: Jul 16 works well for our team (preferred).
- Success metric tweak: for the extract F1 we want to aim for >0.80 on the held-out set (we’ll share the labelled split) — that’s the bar our product team needs to greenlight expansion.
- Latency: 220ms 95th is acceptable as-is; we’ll let you propose tuning if we see regressions under our load.

Open items from our side:
- We’ll share the 500 labelled records by Tue Jul 14 (Rajiv will drop them in the shared S3 link).
- Rajiv requests a short architecture call before kickoff to confirm VPC peering details (15–20 min). Can that be Thurs Jul 15 at 16:00 PT?
- Procurement: Caroline needs the SOW/price estimate to start internal approvals — please include a preliminary MSA-friendly figure in the mutual action plan.

Stakeholders: Elena Moreno (Head of ML), Rajiv Singh (Platform Lead), Caroline Lee (Procurement Manager).

We’d prefer a hosted trial initially unless the security review pushes us to a VPC sandbox.

Elena
Head of ML, Fintell
(elena@fintell.com)

---

Subject: Re: Evaluation charter, milestones, and point people

Elena — great, thanks for the quick confirmation and the slight F1 lift; we can bake that into the success criteria.

Proposed schedule (confirmed):
- Architecture pre-check: Thu Jul 15, 16:00 PT (15–20 min) — Rajiv, Soojin and Marcus will join.
- Kickoff: Fri Jul 16, 10:00 PT (1 hr) — full team. Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/7f3a-eval-kickoff (placeholder).
- Weekly check-ins: Fridays 10:00 PT starting Jul 23 (30 min).
- Final readout: Fri Aug 13, 11:00 PT (45 min) — presentation + metric review.

Action items assigned: 
- Aditya: finalize the mutual action plan and attach a preliminary pricing/usage estimate (will send M-F). Attachment will be: mutual-action-plan.xlsx.
- Soojin: prepare runtime checklist for hosted vs. VPC flows and join the arch pre-check.
- Marcus: perf runbook and target test harness; will prepare a 1-page ops note.

On the legal/procurement note — Caroline, I’ll include an MSA-friendly price cell in the mutual action plan so you can start approvals. If you need an NDA earlier, we can route a short one via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/abcdef

See you on Jul 15/16.

Best,
Aditya

Looping in a quick tech note before the architecture pre-check: 

- For hosted trial: we’ll provision sandbox tokens and a short-lived api key. I’ll add a short runbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/trial-onboarding (internal).
- For VPC sandbox: Rajiv will need the peering CID ranges; Marcus and I will share an infra checklist in the shared drive by EOD.
- Perf harness: Marcus will run the baseline at 50 concurrent clients and post the results to the shared folder; we’ll iterate configs after the first run.

I’ll be on the call Jul 15 16:00 PT.

— Soojin
